beaches.name: Elia (Mykonos)
beaches.summary: Nude use is accepted in the small cove beyond the western end of Elia. Captain Barefoot reader reports from 2016 to 2024 describe the cove over the rocks past the last sunbeds as mostly nude and largely male, while on the main beach nude users are a minority among swimwear users. The Municipality of Mykonos beach page says nothing about nudism.

beaches.name: Panormos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the far half of the beach, away from the taverna end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to 2023; a 2009 forum post and a Mykonos beach guide agree. A 2022 report describes a beach club blocking the car park; a 2023 report says the club was closed.

beaches.name: Agios Sostis
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the far end of the beach, towards the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2003 to 2024; a 2009 forum post and a Mykonos beach guide agree. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Agrari
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the free end and in a small cove towards Elia. A June 2024 review describes the cove as a naturist beach; a naturist directory carries reports from 2010 and 2019 of nudists on the sunbed-free part of the main beach. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Paranga (Paraga)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the western (right) end, including the sunbed rows. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2017, a 2009 forum post and a 2015 review agree; a 2019 Greek listicle lists it. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Super Paradise
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the end by the rocks, opposite the beach club. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to 2017, one from 2012 describing 'nudist area' signs and others finding almost no nudity; Greek listicles from 2018 and 2020 say nudism is allowed on the right side. Who placed the signs is not documented.

beaches.name: Kapari
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on this small beach beyond Agios Ioannis. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2010 and 2011, a 2009 forum post says it is sometimes nude, and Greek listicles from 2019 and 2025 list it. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Paradise Beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported only occasionally, at the two ends of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2019 that range from a few nudists at the ends to none at all; a 2009 forum post lists nude sections at both ends. No designation or signage is documented.
